faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the most common setup and troubleshooting topics.

items.question: How do I report a critical or time-sensitive bug?
items.answer: Create a priority ticket and include the affected analysis IDs or media hashes. The on-call responder will reply within 20 minutes and keep you updated until resolution.

items.question: Where should I send feature ideas or UX feedback?
items.answer: Email product@gravifox.com with context on your workflow, the pain point, and any mockups or references. Every submission is reviewed during our weekly roadmap sync.

items.question: Can I receive billing invoices and receipts in Korean?
items.answer: Yes. Contact support@gravifox.com with your workspace ID and billing cycle. Finance will update your account and resend the latest statements in Korean.

items.question: Do you provide office-hour style consultations?
items.answer: Absolutely. Request a consultation via support@gravifox.com and include preferred times. We host 30-minute sessions to review integration plans or advanced use cases.
